facts.fact: The FY2025 draft budget (PLF 2025) proposes FCFA 115 million, domestically financed, under the finance ministry's section to support the rollout of the SYDONIA World customs system; proposed, not yet passed in this document.
facts.system: Appui au déploiement de SYDONIA World, FY2025 budget

note: Single domestic budget line for a customs IT project.
